name: Potential Energy

description.content: While repairing, use <Activate Ability> to earn Tokens instead of progress, up to [20].
When you repair another Generator, use <Activate Ability> to spend all Tokens and gain [1%] progress for each Token spent.
Whenever you take damage, lose all Tokens.

quote: "When you look a layer deeper, you realize... everything is connected." -Vittorio Toscano
